tasks.title: Homeowner per-task start price override API
tasks.description: PATCH /api/projects/:projectId/tasks/:taskId/start-price — homeowner-only (403 otherwise). Body: {owner_start_price: number | null}. Setting null clears the override and falls back to ai_start_price. Validates owner_start_price >= 0 and that the task belongs to a project owned by the caller and is in editable scope status (e.g. scope_review or published_for_bidding before any bid is accepted). Persists owner_start_price on the existing tasks table column. Response returns the task with {ai_start_price, owner_start_price, effective_start_price}. Also extend GET /api/projects/:id (homeowner view) to expose calculated_start_bid_total = sum of effective_start_price across the project's tasks; this matches what feat-owner-bid-summary uses. Audit: log the change with before/after values.

tasks.title: Homeowner scope review per-task price editor with live total
tasks.description: On the homeowner project scope review page, render each task row with: scope text, photo thumbnails, an AI Suggested label showing ai_start_price (read-only), and an editable Owner Override input pre-filled with owner_start_price when set (placeholder = AI suggested). A Reset link clears the override (sends null to PATCH endpoint). Show effective_start_price below as the value being used. A sticky footer shows Calculated Starting Bid = sum of effective prices across all tasks, updating live as the homeowner edits any row. Validation: non-negative numbers; debounced auto-save calling PATCH /api/projects/:projectId/tasks/:taskId/start-price; toast on success/failure with optimistic UI rollback. Locked once the project status moves past published_for_bidding into accepted (no further edits allowed).
